newsitem.title: USA: McWhorter Technologies sets three-year plan.
newsitem.headline: McWhorter Technologies sets three-year plan.

text.p: McWhorter Technologies Inc Chairman and Chief Executive John Stevens said Wednesday the company expects sales growth of at least four percent annually between 1997 and 2000, with an expanded contribution from new product development.

In comments at the company's annual meeting, Stevens also said McWhorter Technologies expects a minimum of 50 basis points of margin improvements as a result of increased productivity in the next three years.
McWhorter Technologies makes resins used in the paint and coatings industries.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Wednesday at 22-5/8.
